description: First-class cam pause / cam resume operator brake that halts an in-flight cycle at the next story boundary via a dedicated marker file, leaving the sidecar alive and surfacing a distinct paused state in cam status.

userStories.title: Add cam pause / cam resume operator brake backed by a dedicated pause marker
userStories.description: As an operator watching an autonomous loop go wrong, I need a cam pause command that sets a dedicated marker file (and cam resume that clears it) so that I have a graceful brake separate from the phase-derived active field, which the sidecar re-stamps active:true every iteration and therefore silently clobbers.
acceptanceCriteria: cam pause writes a dedicated pause marker file .claude/.cam-pause and cam resume removes it, via a marker module that mirrors drain-kill-switch.ts (named constant + injectable fs seams, never throws). [oracle: bun test test/commands/pause.test.ts]

The pause marker module exports isPauseSet, setPause, and clearPause with injectable fs seams, distinct from the loop-state active/phase field. [oracle: grep -qE 'export function isPauseSet' src/supervisor/pause-marker.ts]

The marker filename .cam-pause is gitignored in both .gitignore and templates/.gitignore, mirroring the .cam-drain-stop entry. [oracle: grep -q '.cam-pause' .gitignore && grep -q '.cam-pause' templates/.gitignore]

cam pause does NOT modify .claude/cam-loop.local.md: a test asserts the state file is byte-unchanged after cam pause runs, proving the pause signal is a separate marker and not the active field. [oracle: bun test test/commands/pause.test.ts]
cam resume clears the pause marker as part of its flow (extends the existing runResume recovery command) so a paused loop can be re-entered. [oracle: bun test test/commands/pause.test.ts]
index.ts dispatches a new pause subcommand (resume is already wired) to runPause. [oracle: grep -qE "case 'pause'" index.ts]
performStop removes the pause marker as part of its per-session marker cleanup loop, per the lifecycle-marker invariant. [oracle: grep -q 'PAUSE_MARKER' src/commands/stop.ts]
Vendor drift check passes after regenerating the embedded copy (bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
The full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Clone src/supervisor/drain-kill-switch.ts into a new src/supervisor/pause-marker.ts: export PAUSE_MARKER = '.cam-pause' and setPause/clearPause/isPauseSet with injectable DrainWriteFn/DrainRemoveFn/DrainExistsFn-style seams (mkdirSync recursive on set, presence is the signal, never throws). New src/commands/pause.ts mirrors src/commands/drain.ts print-path structure (emitTitle/emitOk/emitSectionHeading). Extend src/commands/resume.ts (runResume) to clearPause(claudeDir) at the start of its flow so cam resume clears the brake before its existing 4-mode recovery. index.ts: add a new 'pause' case (resume already dispatches at index.ts:2926); register 'pause' in the command list near index.ts:2576. Add PAUSE_MARKER to the performStop removal loop in src/commands/stop.ts (import beside DRAIN_STOP_MARKER at line 43; add to the marker array near line 576) per patterns.md:56 lifecycle-marker invariant. Add '.claude/.cam-pause' to both .gitignore (beside .cam-drain-stop line 56) and templates/.gitignore (beside line 33). templates/.gitignore is walked by scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts into src/vendor/_generated.ts, so run `bun run embed-vendor` after the edit, then `bun run embed-vendor:check` must pass. Gotcha (spec): do NOT reuse the active field for pause; parseStateFile ignores a raw active field when a phase key is present (status.ts:262-270) and makeOnProgress re-stamps active:true every iteration (host.ts:389-399). Test test/commands/pause.test.ts must (a) verify set/clear via injected seams and real tmpdir, and (b) write a cam-loop.local.md fixture, run runPause, and assert its bytes are unchanged.

userStories.title: Halt the supervisor inner story loop cooperatively when the pause marker is set
userStories.description: As an operator, I need the supervisor to stop dispatching the next story when the pause marker is set, halting cooperatively at the story boundary without tearing down the sidecar process or its in-memory merge-watch timers, so that pausing is a graceful brake rather than a process kill.
acceptanceCriteria: RunSupervisorOptions gains an injected pause predicate (isPaused?: () => boolean) consulted at the inner story-loop boundary (loop.ts:953) before dispatching the next story; when it returns true the loop stops dispatching and returns a cooperative paused SupervisorResult status without a terminal teardown. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/pause-halt.test.ts]
The production pause predicate is wired into buildSupervisorOptions in src/supervisor/host.ts to read the pause marker via isPauseSet. [oracle: grep -qE 'isPauseSet' src/supervisor/host.ts]

Halting on pause does not invoke any sidecar/pane teardown seam and does not exit the process: the test asserts the returned status is the cooperative paused value and no teardown side-effect function was called, distinct from cam stop. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/pause-halt.test.ts]
After the marker is cleared (cam resume), a re-entered runSupervisor dispatches the remaining unpassed stories rather than re-planning. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/pause-resume.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
The full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Add optional isPaused?: () => boolean to the RunSupervisorOptions bag (loop.ts:330-530) and consult it at the top of the `outer: while` inner loop (loop.ts:953) BEFORE dispatch; when true, break to a cooperative return with a new SupervisorResult status 'paused' (extend the status union near the other returns at loop.ts:940/1005/1024). The cooperative return must not unlink the state file, kill panes, or exit: it just ends the current runSupervisor invocation so the sidecar idles. Wire the production predicate in src/supervisor/host.ts:buildSupervisorOptions (patterns.md:44 sidecar dep-wiring, never duplicate inline): isPaused: () => isPauseSet(claudeDir), importing isPauseSet from src/supervisor/pause-marker.ts (US-001). Gotcha (spec): the outer readActive gate (loop.ts:2245-2301) is inter-cycle only and cannot interrupt an in-flight runSupervisor, which is exactly why the injected predicate at the inner-loop boundary is required. Keep sidecar + merge-watch timers alive: pausing is NOT cam stop (src/commands/stop.ts kills the tmux session). test/supervisor/pause-halt.test.ts: inject isPaused=()=>true plus spy teardown seams and assert paused status + zero teardown calls. test/supervisor/pause-resume.test.ts: isPaused flips false, assert the next unpassed story is dispatched (continue, not re-plan). Sidecar-executed rebuild is required after ship (bash scripts/build-release.sh --install, restart cam sidecar) since loop.ts/host.ts run inside the live sidecar.

userStories.title: Render a distinct operator-paused state in cam status
userStories.description: As an operator, I need cam status to show a distinct operator-initiated paused state read from the pause marker so that I can tell an intentional brake apart from the ordinary non-implementing phases (idle, planning, shipping) that already render as active:false.
acceptanceCriteria: cam status reads the pause marker and renders a distinct operator-paused state via the print path, not conflated with the existing active:false 'paused' label. [oracle: bun test test/commands/status-paused.test.ts]
A distinct StatusState value 'operator-paused' is introduced and rendered by renderStateIndicator, separate from 'idle'/'active'/'paused'. [oracle: grep -qE 'operator-paused' src/commands/status.ts]
The operator-paused render uses the non-interactive print path and introduces no Ink dependency in status.ts. [oracle: ! grep -q "from 'ink" src/commands/status.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
The full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: src/commands/status.ts: extend StatusState (currently 'idle' | 'active' | 'paused' at status.ts:187) with 'operator-paused'; read the pause marker via isPauseSet(claudeDir) from src/supervisor/pause-marker.ts (US-001) and let it take precedence over the phase-derived label so an operator pause renders distinctly. Render it in renderStateIndicator (status.ts:511-513) with its own glyph/label and add a matching trailing hint (status.ts:601-602), NOT folded into the existing active:false 'paused' branch (status.ts:460, which is the phase-conflation gotcha). Print path only (process.stdout / src/logging/screen helpers); this story deliberately avoids Ink and ink-testing-library, so no new external library is introduced. test/commands/status-paused.test.ts: with the marker present assert the operator-paused indicator renders and is distinct from the plain active:false paused label.
